newsitem.title: UK: Gecamine cobalt/copper workers on strike - traders.
newsitem.headline: Gecamine cobalt/copper workers on strike - traders.

text.p: Workers at Zaire cobalt and copper producer Gecamines are on strike, London minor metals traders said on Wednesday.
They said Gecamines workers, along with many other workers in Zaire, began a protest last week over the introduction of new bank notes.
Gecamines was not available for comment, but a close source to the major cobalt producer believed output was continuing at a reduced rate.
High grade cobalt was indicated at around $22 a pound early on Wednesday, little changed from levels that prevailed last week.
London traders said the market was closely eyeing Gecamines for further developments.
Gecamines produce around 5,000 tonnes of cobalt per year. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542-8075
